dog.description_text:
Lee is more than just a dog—he's a loyal companion, a source of endless joy, and a beloved member of the family. Whether he's greeting everyone with a wagging tail, curling up for a nap, or exploring the world one sniff at a time, Lee brings happiness wherever he goes. He has a gentle heart, a playful spirit, and a special way of making every day brighter. His favorite things include treats, belly rubs, long walks, and spending time with the people he loves most. Life with Lee is filled with laughter, love, and unforgettable memories.

This animal is located at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. We are open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age appropriate shots. Apply for Adoption Today!
